# unix

> Garden tag: unix

## Garden

- [How Do You Ask a CLI for Help?](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/cli-help-patterns.md): A typology of command-line help patterns, why they collide with your arguments, and how to test what agents actually need.
- [A History of the 'ls' command](https://blog.cani.ne.jp/garden/a-history-of-the-ls-command.md): Who wrote ls? Tracing the directory listing command from MIT's Compatible Time-Sharing System through Unix to GNU coreutils.
